description: Trimble is a leading technology solutions and platform provider, enabling office professionals and field workers to connect their workflows and industry lifecycles, driving a more productive, efficient and sustainable future, with a focus on the industries that build, maintain and move the world, and the comprehensive depth and breadth of its solutions are transforming the way the world works. It innovates at the intersection of the digital and physical worlds with solutions that span the world's foundational industries, including building, civil and infrastructure construction, geospatial, natural resources, utilities and transportation, and it exists to empower its customers, including asset owners, general and specialty contractors, architects, engineers and designers, surveyors, energy and utility companies, transportation shippers and carriers, as well as state, federal and municipal governments, with productivity and sustainability at the heart of who it is.
